units.source_text: 问：三百年后——等到公版之后，我的全集将为数万人争先抢购。

en.t: Question: Three hundred years from now—once they have entered the public domain—tens of thousands of people will be rushing to buy my complete works.

units.source_text: 跟我同居的女友怎么样了呢？

en.t: What will have become of the girlfriend who was living with me?
